description: This PHP source file is responsible for displaying and managing the inventory terms and conditions within the Settings module of the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves data from the database, processes request parameters, and renders the associated Smarty template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty wrapper class used for rendering templates within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the specified Smarty template, in this case 'Settings/InventoryTerms.tpl', with assigned variables.
